meta.notes: Research has not been completed. Ship details require user confirmation.

blocks.title: Port window & berth
paragraphs: Confirm arrival/departure dates, berth or anchorage, landing point and return arrangements with the ship.

blocks.title: Daily routine & leave
paragraphs: Confirm routine, leave expiry, overnight leave and restrictions from current ship instructions.

blocks.title: Money & payments
paragraphs: Research local currency, payment acceptance, ATMs and tipping.

blocks.title: Language, phones & power
paragraphs: Research language, useful phrases, country calling code, connectivity, plug types and voltage.

blocks.title: Arrival essentials
paragraphs: Research entry requirements and local official guidance; do not assume nationality, visa status or military exemptions.

blocks.title: Seasonal conditions
paragraphs: Research the local climate across the year. If visit dates are unknown, do not invent a visit-specific forecast.

blocks.title: Weather hazards & official forecasts
paragraphs: Research local seasonal hazards and link the national weather service and relevant warning authority.

blocks.title: Port orientation
paragraphs: Identify the port, city and public terminal area. Actual ship berth and access arrangements require ship confirmation.

blocks.title: Key places
paragraphs: Add map links for the port area, city centre, transport hubs and relevant public services.

blocks.title: Getting around & returning to ship
paragraphs: Research local transport, official operators, payment, accessibility, last services and return constraints. Date all fares and schedules.

blocks.title: Eating, drinking & shopping
paragraphs: Research local food, useful neighbourhoods, customs and options for different budgets. Populate all four venue categories; explain when a category is unavailable.

blocks.title: Where to stay
paragraphs: Research practical areas to stay, transport connections and booking considerations. Populate the hotel list with official websites where available.

blocks.title: Travel advisory & local rules
paragraphs: Check current Government of Canada advice and relevant local authorities; record source and date for restrictions.

blocks.title: Local hazards & health
paragraphs: Research locally relevant hazards, drinking water, food safety and environmental conditions using authoritative sources.

blocks.title: Medical care & consular assistance
paragraphs: Confirm emergency services, appropriate hospitals and Canadian consular coverage. Do not assume 24-hour service, accreditation, coverage or English availability.

blocks.title: Local history & culture
paragraphs: Research the port and its communities, key events and respectful cultural context.

blocks.title: Places to learn more
paragraphs: Link local museums, heritage institutions or authoritative history sources.
